reviews.title: Easy to install and quiet
reviews.comment: I love these silent fans, easy to install and came with screws.
reviews.author: Bob

reviews.title: Good air movement.
reviews.comment: I have 5 of these in my tower. My PC has never run quieter and cooler. The amount of air they move is fantastic. Great bang for buck.
reviews.author: Kei Dimas

reviews.title: So quiet!
reviews.comment: Replaced three fans when my previous 120mm started rattling. These runs very quiet and push a good amount of air. They also have a daisy chain option in case your board does not have enough fan connections. One of the other things I like is the screw holes have a rubber gasket to minimize rattle. Will buy again for sure.
reviews.author: N. Mcclellan

reviews.title: Great fans for the price!
reviews.comment: Bought these for my brother's desktop, he's very happy with the performance and temperatures!
reviews.author: Lawrence Wilson

reviews.title: Thermalright TL-C14C X3 CPU Case Fans
reviews.comment: I have been buying Computer Fans Since the 80's (Radio Shack & Others) & I have found these fans to be the BEST. I bought some of their 120mm fans last winter & I liked them so much that when it came time to buy some 140mm I jupped right for these fans. I definitely would buy again & would recommend to a friend.
reviews.author: Mykey_D
